source: Authored for S06 (Issue #145) from the discovery probe rules in docs/architecture/discovery.md and the internal-rediscovery rule in connection.md: one bounded internal rediscovery of the saved UUID, no scan UI, no DiscoveryEvent.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, token, serial or certificate. Hosts are placeholders such as [host-b]; address-like and identifying device-info fields are placeholders; UUIDs are randomly generated for this fixture.
notes: Two televisions answer one bounded rediscovery: the saved UUID at a new address and a different UUID at another. Only the saved UUID may be accepted, and the rediscovery holds the shared multicast lock for its bound only.
